confidence_notes: Overall low. Beer, coffee and meal anchors rest on loosely matching aggregator figures and local guides, several undated or from small samples, converted at about R$5.25 per USD (implied by the sources, not a live rate). Cocktail and wine_glass are beer-relative estimates because only undated cocktail ranges and no current per-glass wine price were found; midrange_meal_2p is adjusted from an expat-area two-person dinner figure that included wine. Restaurant figures exclude the optional 10% service charge. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July stay outside the December-February peak, not drawn from live listings or booking pages. FX comes from a search excerpt of the RBA exchange-rates page (18 Nov 2026 USD line); the F11.1 file was not opened and no 19 Nov value was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors follow Florianópolis aggregator price points and local guides; Expatistan overall cost-of-living comparisons (roughly level with Sofia, about 16 percent below Split) were used only as a loose sanity check. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of mid-sized Brazilian beach-city hotel and hostel pricing.
